slides.title: What happened
slides.big: Warsh declined to say if the Fed will hike again
slides.body: Speaking in Bangkok on Oct. 16, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said he won't prejudge the October or December meetings.

slides.title: Where rates stand
slides.body: The Fed raised its target range by a quarter point in September, its first hike since 2023. Minutes show most officials expect another increase this year.

slides.title: Why it matters
slides.big: Oct. 27 to 28 is the next FOMC meeting
slides.body: September CPI rose 3.7% from a year earlier. Borrowing costs for loans and mortgages follow the Fed's path.

slides.title: Bottom line
items: No hint on October or December
